title: webpack-cli WDS v6: packages keys removed from lockfileVersion 3
changedFact: webpack-cli package-lock.json drops eight packages-map keys (array-flatten@1.1.1, binary-extensions@2.3.0, core-util-is@1.0.3, destroy@1.2.0, detect-node@2.1.0, faye-websocket@0.11.4, follow-redirects@1.16.0, http-proxy@1.18.1) when webpack-dev-server moves to v6; those keys exist at cbd3a24 and are absent at 3664b9d.

source.note: webpack/webpack tracks yarn.lock, not package-lock.json; this npm lockfileVersion 3 pair is the webpack-org stand-in.
